plugs.name: dimmer-A1
plugs._note: one gang of a double Tuya dimmer switch (category tgkg). Give it a lighting role (white, white_plus, blue or moon) only after the lamp on it is known to be dimmable by a phase-cut dimmer. level_cap (0..1) is a hard ceiling on its brightness.

plugs.name: heater-gate
plugs._note: the 4th plug, feeding the Inkbird (or fed by it). Set driver to tinytuya and fill id and ip once paired. revert_dp is model-specific (9 on the KMC 30153, 11 on the SP10): read it from the wizard mapping. Set the plug's power-on state to ON in Smart Life.
